How to announce a price increase to customers: email, text and FAQ answers (AI template)

The email is the easy part. The hard part is answering "why?" over and over. So prepare the whole kit in one go.

Copy this:

"I'm raising prices at [BUSINESS] on [DATE]. What changes: [WHICH SERVICES + BY HOW MUCH]. The honest reason: [REASON]. What stays the same: [WHAT CUSTOMERS KEEP]. Write: 1) a short, warm email under 120 words, 2) a 2-line text for regulars, 3) answers to the 4 questions customers are most likely to ask. Calm, no over-apologizing, no hype."

I tried it for an invented dog-walking business. The email said the reason once, spent more words on what stays the same, and offered current bookings the old rate through March.

Fill in your real numbers yourself. Never let the AI guess them.
